Playbook Snippets (quick templates & probes)
Sections: Executive Touch, Technical Risk, Commercial Incentives, Escalation Path

Executive Touch:
- Subject: Redwood QBR — results & next steps (30 min)
- Body bullets: 1) Top usage wins (tokens saved, latency improvements), 2) Cost/ARR impact, 3) 1-2 asks (commit, product rollout), 4) Next meeting suggestion

Technical Risk Probe:
- Checklist: reproduce perf issue, timeline for mitigation, patch ETA, workaround availability, SLO impact

Commercial Incentives:
- Suggested levers: 10% prepay discount (12mo), reserved capacity trial (Dedicated) for 3 months, migration credit for Private onboarding, ROI-based credits tied to measured savings

Escalation Path:
- If renewal probability drops below 40%: 1) CS MGR sync + Solutions Eng, 2) Open exec-to-exec invite, 3) Escalate to sales lead for commercial flexibility

Micro-templates: 1) "We've identified X token savings — propose 15-min demo"; 2) "Security deliverable status: SOW version 3 attached; can we align on sign-off by {date}?"

Meeting cadence: Weekly renewal scrub (Wed 10am PT) — owners expected to update probability and notes 24h prior. Green highlight = probability >=80%, Yellow = 50–79%, Red = <50%.

Supplemental: Cohort definitions & scoring rubric
Columns: Field | Definition

Customer Tier | Strategic: >$250k ARR or enterprise with private deployments; Growth: $75k–250k; Mid-Market: $25k–75k; SMB: < $25k
Usage Signal | High: sustained >70% utilization of allocated capacity; Medium: 30–70%; Low: <30%
Churn Risk Score calculation (manual): base 100 minus (probability*1). Flags: Support tickets (>=2 last 90d) add 15, Security blockers add 25, Procurement delay add 10

How to use: Export this sheet to QBR deck. For any account with Risk Score > 60, schedule escalation and mark as "At-Risk" in the Pipeline Summary.
